baseline.policy: Use a definition-stable historical MCD earnings-event cohort with positive U.S. comparable sales and positive comparable guest counts, preserving the frozen next-open clock, notional, costs and H10/H20 exits.

execution_envelope.capacity_constraint: At most one existing paper cash slot and positive-contribution ticker share below 40%; no portfolio allocation, production signal or order effect
execution_envelope.costs_and_carry: Repository cash-equity commission and slippage assumptions at identical notional; no financing, borrow credit or option carry
execution_envelope.intended_instrument: MCD common stock in a historical research-only cohort; long common equity only, with no option, leverage, inverse product, proxy or short leg
execution_envelope.liquidity_dependency: Canonical OHLCV, next-regular-session-open availability, gap-cancel, stale-price and minimum-liquidity controls must pass
execution_envelope.timing_constraint: SEC acceptance, guest-count, check or mix, franchised-margin, price, universe and any independent market-prior fields must be known before each simulated decision open

falsifier: Reject or park if no observable pre-event market prior can separate expected from surprising demand quality; if historical guest-count, check or mix and franchised-margin definitions cannot be frozen as-known; if any standard window has fewer than five executable treatment decisions; if D0-D3 finds a frozen near-neighbor; if one ticker exceeds 40% of positive treatment value; or if H10 and H20 replacement value is not weaker than the positive-traffic baseline after identical costs.
hypothesis: For MCD earnings events, when U.S. comparable sales are positive because of check or product mix while comparable guest counts are negative and sales-driven franchised margin dollars rise, continuation may be weaker over fixed next-open H10 and H20 horizons than positive-traffic events because nominal franchise economics can temporarily mask demand fragility; use the condition only as a deterministic research exclusion or abstention tag.
replacement_value_comparator: Zero-return cash, identical-interval SPY and QQQ, the exact unconditioned MCD earnings-event row and the positive-guest-count baseline at the same decision clock, notional, costs and H10/H20 exit policy.
title: MCD price-mix demand-fragility earnings lead

treatment.policy: Keep every production rule unchanged. Attach a research exclusion or abstention tag only when source-dated facts known before the decision open show positive U.S. comparable sales led by check or product mix, negative comparable guest counts and rising sales-driven franchised-margin dollars; otherwise abstain from the treatment label.

why_not_arbitraged: The event facts are public and may be fully priced. A residual edge can exist only if investors overweight nominal comparable sales and franchised-margin dollars while underweighting traffic breadth, working-capital and currency confounds; this must survive independent expectation, PIT, transmission, touch-density, novelty and exact replacement-value tests rather than rely on the filing narrative.
